tool.name: Compute consensus profiles
tool.command:
mkdir pycytominer_output &&
## Convert the input to CSV for pycytominer #if $profiles.ext in ["tsv", "tabular"] python '$__tool_directory__/format_converter_csvtsv.py' -i '$profiles' -o 'profiles.csv' -c tsv2csv && #else cp '$profiles' 'profiles.csv' && #end if
## Since the strata are input as integers, they need to be converted in a a comma separated string columns_headers=`head -n1 'profiles.csv' | cut -d, -f'$replicate_columns'` &&
pycytominer consensus
--profiles 'profiles.csv' --output_file './pycytominer_output/output.csv' --output_type 'csv' --operation '$operation' --replicate_columns "\$columns_headers" &&
## Convert the result back to TSV for the Galaxy dataset python '$__tool_directory__/format_converter_csvtsv.py' -i 'pycytominer_output/output.csv' -o '$output' -c csv2tsv

param.name: profiles
param.label: Input feature-readouts table
param.help: Table with features extracted from images, normally after feature selection

param.name: replicate_columns
param.label: Column with unique condition
param.help: Select column with the unique condition, meaning where replicates share all of these values

param.name: operation
param.label: Reduction operation
param.help: Operation to apply to the cell-profiling table. Moderated z-score is recommended for large screens.

tool.help:
**Collapses replicate wells into one profile per biological condition.**
The replicate wells are collapsed by the *Reduction operation* across replicates.
Documentation: https://pycytominer.readthedocs.io/en/stable/walkthroughs/pycytominer_cli.html#Step-5:-Consensus
